Requirement: The system shall work without registration or login; the first launch shall create a local profile automatically.
The system shall let the user set an optional profile name and avatar.
The system shall let the user enable an optional app lock (PIN or password) required at launch and after a configurable idle time.
The system shall store the app lock secret only as a salted hash (BCrypt or Argon2).
The system shall allow a forgotten app lock to be reset only by erasing all application data after a clear confirmation.
The system shall let the user delete all application data (library, files, settings) from Settings after confirmation.
The system shall support multiple local profiles, each with a separate library.
The system shall import PDF and EPUB files via a file picker, drag-and-drop onto the window, recursive folder import, and Explorer's Open with, including many files at once.
The system shall copy imported files into the application library folder by default, with an optional mode that only links to the original path and warns when a link is broken.
The system shall validate imports by extension and file signature (magic bytes) and reject files above a configurable maximum size (default 500 MB).
The system shall show import progress and report success or failure per file.
The system shall automatically extract title, author, language, page count (where available), and cover image from each file.
The system shall generate a cover thumbnail from the first PDF page when no cover is embedded.
The system shall let users edit book metadata (title, author, description, tags) and replace the cover.
The system shall let users remove a book from the library, with an option to also delete the stored copy; progress and annotations are removed after confirmation.
The system shall display the library in grid and list views with sorting (title, author, date added, last read, progress).
The system shall let users create collections or shelves and assign books to one or more of them.
The system shall let users mark favorites and shall show reading status (Not started, Reading, Finished).
The system shall detect duplicate imports using a file hash and warn the user.
The system shall provide a Continue Reading section showing recently opened books.
The system shall let the user watch a folder and import new files placed in it automatically.
The installer shall offer to register the app for .pdf and .epub files so a double-click opens them in Wicked Reader.
The system shall render PDF pages in the reader window using canvas with a text layer so text is selectable.
The system shall support continuous scroll mode and single-page and two-page (spread) modes.
The system shall support zoom (fit width, fit page, custom percentage from 25% to 500%) and pinch-to-zoom on touch devices.
The system shall support page rotation.
The system shall display the PDF outline (bookmarks) as a navigable table of contents when present.
The system shall provide a page thumbnail sidebar for quick navigation.
The system shall allow jumping to a page number and navigating with keyboard shortcuts and touch swipe.
The system shall load pages lazily and read the file from the local service with HTTP range requests so large PDFs open quickly.
The system shall provide a dark reading mode for PDFs (color inversion filter) with adjustable brightness and contrast.
The system shall support following internal links and open external links in the default browser safely.
The system shall render EPUB 2 and EPUB 3 content with reflowable text, images, and embedded CSS.
The system shall support paginated mode (page-turn) and continuous scroll mode.
The system shall allow users to change font family, font size, line height, margins, and text alignment.
The system shall provide themes: Light, Sepia, Dark, Night (true black), and a custom theme with user-defined colors.
The system shall display the EPUB table of contents and allow navigation by chapter.
The system shall show reading position as percentage and estimated time left in chapter and book.
The system shall support single-page and two-page layouts depending on viewport width.
The system shall handle fixed-layout EPUBs where supported by the rendering library.
The system shall sanitize EPUB content to block scripts and unsafe external resources.
The system shall support right-to-left languages and vertical writing where supported by the renderer.
The system shall provide full-text search within the open book (PDF and EPUB) with a result list showing context snippets.
The system shall highlight search matches in the page and allow next and previous match navigation.
The system shall support case-sensitive and whole-word search options.
The system shall allow jumping directly to a search result.
The system shall automatically save the reading position (page number for PDF, CFI for EPUB) and percentage while the user reads.
The system shall resume each book at its last saved position and offer a setting to reopen the last book at launch.
The system shall debounce progress saves (for example every 5 seconds or on page change) and flush any pending save when the window closes.
The system shall track reading sessions (start time, duration) to produce reading statistics.
The system shall commit progress and annotation changes transactionally so a crash or forced shutdown loses at most the last few seconds of progress.
The system shall let the user export and import progress and annotations as a JSON file to move between PCs.
The system shall allow users to add, view, and delete bookmarks at the current position with an optional label.
The system shall allow users to select text and highlight it in a choice of at least five colors.
The system shall allow users to attach a note to any highlight or position and edit or delete it.
The system shall persist highlights and re-render them accurately when the book is reopened or the layout changes.
The system shall provide an annotations panel listing bookmarks, highlights, and notes with click-to-jump.
The system shall allow exporting annotations of a book as Markdown, PDF, or JSON.
The system shall provide a copy-with-citation option for selected text.
The system shall provide a dictionary lookup for selected words.
The system shall store reader preferences per profile (theme, font, size, spacing, layout mode) and apply them on every launch.
The system shall allow overriding preferences per book.
The system shall provide a distraction-free full-screen mode where the toolbar auto-hides.
The system shall provide a keyboard shortcut help overlay.
The system shall offer an application-wide light and dark UI theme following system preference by default.
The system shall provide smooth page-turn and transition animations that can be disabled by the user (reduced motion).
The system shall start the local service and MySQL automatically at launch, wait for readiness, and show a clear error screen with a Retry button and a link to the logs if either fails.
The system shall allow only one running instance; a second launch shall focus the existing window and open the requested file.
The system shall back up the library (database dump, book files, covers, settings) to a user-chosen ZIP file and restore from it.
The system shall show app version, data folder location, book count, and storage used in Settings.
The system shall let the user view and export application logs for troubleshooting.
The uninstaller shall ask whether to keep or remove user data.
The system shall offer scheduled automatic backups (daily or weekly, keeping the last N).
The system shall check for updates only when the user enables it, and make no other network calls.
